context: Q3 2026: three consecutive deficit months (about 84,000 mt LCE) while prices fell; destocking of about 68,000 mt filled the deficit, so inventory acted as a buffer.
SMM revised its weekly inventory scope on 4 Sep 2026: the headline jumped from 78,800 t to about 175,000 t. Do not compare levels across the break.

Per SMM, LFP output implies roughly 34,000 t LCE/week of carbonate use. No dated days-of-inventory series is loaded, so the dashboard does not score cover. Mysteel projects inventory days near 15 in November.
Nov 17: LC2701 rallied to a 93,180 close on lower open interest while spot kept falling. That is consistent with short covering, but aggregate OI cannot identify who initiated trades.

GFEX parameters 18 Nov (third-party compile): speculative margin 15%, price limit 13%, fee 0.008% of turnover. Exchange notices also cap daily opening volume: check contract-level limits before treating any spread as tradable.
Cochilco's Q4 price near US$19,000/t is far above current spot of about US$13,700/t: treat with caution.
